summary: Reproduced and diagnosed test flakiness and shared state leakage: tests passed in isolation but failed in the full suite due to broader fixture scoping retaining committed database records across test cases.
evidence: Observed test failure in tests/test_module09_integration_suite.py: test_6_url_validation_rejections failed with 'assert 4 == 0' when run in the full suite, but passed cleanly when run in isolation (-k test_6).

Formed accurate diagnostic hypothesis: previous tests (test_1, test_2, test_4, test_5) committed records into the shared database because the cleanup fixture was scoped to the module rather than per-function, leaking state between test boundaries.
